item.title: Let's start
item.description:
***what should I say？*** Describe myself first,I am an undergraduate student in BUPT.I want to write something to record my growth experience here.The pace of technological **iteration** is extremely rapid.If we engage in computer-related work, we will encounter a wide varieties of new technologies.Therefore,It's necessary to write it down. Meanwhile,I'd like to improve my English level, so I try to insist on writing in English. ***something about my plan for future*** In this era of AI,an enormous amount of information **floods in** ,**even more so than** in the Internet age.It's hard to keep up with the pace of development.I can't predict the future trend, so It's **sufficient** to accumulate my knowledge now and set a short-term small goal. The final point I want to mention is that this blog **solely encompasses** some ideas and records **presented in** English.**Regarding** matters related to technology,I will document them on Feishu and insert the link right here.Alright,I've **expounded** all I intended to.Now,let's commence.
